description: Required CI contexts that must report a run at the exact head SHA before merge. A context that never starts is ABSENT — no failing row, nothing pending — and naive green logic ships unverified code. This registry plus ci-required-contexts-guard.ts turns that silent-green into a block. Fail closed: API error, timeout, or missing run = block, never green.
